extracted.intended_audience: self-directed learners of French (beginners and intermediate), people wishing to review grammar, slang, proverbs, or learn via songs
extracted.subtask_description: Free online adaptation of the FSI French basic course offering two tracks (beginners and intermediate), each with 12 lessons that focus on listening, grammar explanations, examples, quizzes, and multimedia (songs, videos, flashcards).

rubrics_metrics.name: 100% Free French Lessons
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn French Online for Free — the site advertises free French courses and resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site repeatedly emphasizes that courses and lessons are free (e.g., 'Learn French Online for Free', 'Free French language course for beginners').

rubrics_metrics.name: FSI French basic course adaptation
rubrics_metrics.description: Our free French courses are an online adaptation of the FSI French basic course.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The curriculum/methodology follows or is adapted from the FSI basic course approach, implying a structured, proven syllabus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two main courses: beginners and intermediate
rubrics_metrics.description: We propose 2 main courses: French for beginners and Intermediate French.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Material is organized into at least two learner levels so users can choose appropriate track.

rubrics_metrics.name: Course length: 12 lessons per course
rubrics_metrics.description: Each course includes 12 free french lessons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both beginner and intermediate courses consist of 12 lessons each, providing a predictable course scope.

rubrics_metrics.name: Listening-based speaking practice
rubrics_metrics.description: With our online French lessons, you will be able to learn to speak French by listening to French words, French phrases and French dialogues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes listening to words/phrases/dialogues as a pathway to speaking; audio/dialogue exposure is a core pedagogical element.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simple explanations of French grammar
rubrics_metrics.description: Each lesson also includes simple explanations of French grammar.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Grammar is presented in accessible, simplified form rather than dense academic exposition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Many examples of grammar in use
rubrics_metrics.description: Many examples of French grammar in use are provided within lessons.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical usage examples accompany explanations to illustrate grammar points in context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quizzes and exercises to test skills
rubrics_metrics.description: You will also be able to test your French language skills with quizzes and exercises.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Formative assessment is provided (quizzes/exercises) so learners can check progress; explicit 'Test yourself' items appear at lesson checkpoints.

rubrics_metrics.name: Targeted review of particular grammar aspects
rubrics_metrics.description: The website can also be useful to people who wish to learn or review particular aspects of French grammar.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources are suitable for focused revision of specific grammar topics, not just full-course progression.

rubrics_metrics.name: French sayings and proverbs content
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn more about French proverbs and sayings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dedicated material on proverbs/sayings to build cultural and idiomatic understanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: French slang and idioms content
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn French slang and idioms online.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resources explicitly include colloquial language, slang and idiomatic expressions to improve real-world comprehension and usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Learning through songs with multimedia
rubrics_metrics.description: You will also be able to discover some popular French songs (all with music video, French lyrics and English translation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Multimedia (music videos) plus bilingual lyrics are provided; the site notes that learning through music can be 'fun and rewarding'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Online flashcards and 'goodies'
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn French with online flashcards and other goodies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supplementary study aids (flashcards) are available to support vocabulary retention and review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pronunciation improvement tips
rubrics_metrics.description: French pronunciation Tips to improve your french pronunciation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Dedicated pronunciation guidance/tips are provided to help learners refine spoken French.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lesson checkpoint tests (formative assessment)
rubrics_metrics.description: Basic French course lessons include 'Test yourself' at Lesson 6 and Lesson 12 (for both course 1 and course 2).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Structured checkpoints are placed mid-course and end-course for learners to self-assess progress.

rubrics_metrics.name: Local/in-person course information (Bangkok)
rubrics_metrics.description: Information about learning French in Thailand / French courses in Bangkok is provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site offers a bridge to in-person instruction or local course info for learners seeking classroom options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feedback channel to site maintainers
rubrics_metrics.description: Thank you for visiting our site. Please feel free to send feedback.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users are invited to provide feedback, indicating an openness to user suggestions or error reports.
